description: Local reflection capture using Three CubeCamera and PMREMGenerator. ReflectionProbe publishes { envMap, envMapIntensity } through its render prop for explicit binding to native materials. Optional createVolumeReflectionMaterial and createVolumeReflectionPhysicalMaterial factories provide volume blending, priority and box-projected parallax across mixed-resolution probes. The editor shows probe volumes, typed settings, capture status and Recapture; authored settings remain in JSX.
title: Reflection probes
